summary: Triumph Financial filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend on its 7.125% Series C Fixed-Rate Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock of $17.81 per share, equivalent to $0.44525 per depositary share (each a 1/40th interest). The dividend is payable September 30, 2026 to holders of record September 15, 2026. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine preferred dividend declaration. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Watch for ordinary dividend coverage and preferred accrual trends, not deal dynamics.
